function.name: weather_forecast
function.description: Retrieves the weather forecast for a specified location and date, including temperature, precipitation, and wind conditions. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The geographic location for the forecast, in the format 'City, State' or 'City, Country', such as 'San Francisco, CA' or 'London, UK'.

date.description: The date for which the forecast is being retrieved, formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

temperature_unit.description: The unit of measurement for temperature.

include_humidity.description: Whether to include humidity percentage in the forecast.

include_wind.description: Whether to include wind speed and direction in the forecast.

Shashi Tej Reddy is an Indian politician and former army officer.  
He entered politics after retiring from the Indian Army, where he held the rank of Brigadier. In 2019 he was elected to the Lok Sabha from the Nandyal constituency in Andhra Pradesh on a Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) ticket.  

During his tenure as a Member of Parliament he served as Minister of State for Defence (Independent Charge) from 2019 until 2021. He resigned from the ministry in 2021 amid allegations of corruption and later left the BJP in 2022.  

Reddy has been involved in several controversies, including accusations of links with extremist groups and financial irregularities. He has also been a former director of the National Institute of Sports.
